seo.title: Check Yourself — Quick Camera Mirror for macOS
seo.description: A lightweight macOS menu bar app to check your appearance before meetings. One click, instant camera. No accounts, no tracking.

hero.label: Camera Mirror
hero.title: One click. Camera ready.
text: A tiny macOS menu bar app that gives you instant access to your camera. Check your look before the meeting starts.

items.title: Menu Bar Access
items.text: Click the icon in your menu bar and your camera opens instantly. No app windows, no dock clutter.

items.title: Mirror View
items.text: The camera feed is mirrored so it feels natural — just like looking in a real mirror before heading out.

items.title: Zoom Levels
items.text: Switch between 1x, 1.5x, and 2x zoom. Your preference is remembered between sessions.

items.title: Camera On Demand
items.text: The camera is only active when the popover is open. Close it and the camera stops immediately.

items.title: Lightweight
items.text: Lives quietly in your menu bar. Uses almost no resources when idle. Launches at login if you want.

items.title: Completely Private
items.text: No network requests, no analytics, no data collection. Your camera feed stays on your Mac. Period.

sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking pixels. No telemetry. Check Yourself doesn't make network requests. Your camera feed never leaves your Mac.

cta.title: Look good. Feel good.
cta.text: Free on the Mac App Store. No account required.
